'''Tal'dira's Chir'daki''' was an "[[Ugly/Legends|Ugly]]"-designed starfighter created by the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] by attaching the wings and [[KX9 laser cannon/Legends|KX9 laser cannons]] of a [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing]] onto the spherical pod of a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighter]]. This particular starfigher was flown by the premier Twi'lek warrior, [[Tal'dira]], where he acted as the [[Flight leader/Legends|flight commander]] for a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[Chir'daki]].

==History==
In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> [[Tal'dira]] flew his [[Chir'daki]] with his squadmates to intercept the New Republic's [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] after they had been caught attempting to procure the [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Ryll/Legends|ryll]] from the [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] city of [[Kala'uun/Legends|Kala'uun]]. But, after [[Rogue Leader/Legends|Rogue Leader]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] proved himself to Tal'dira as an honorable warrior, Tal'dira departed from the city's [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] aboard his Chir'daki.<ref name="KT" /> 

===The Bacta War===
In the succeeding weeks,<ref name="TERC" /> Tal'dira offered himself and his Chir'daki to Rogue Squadron's private guerrilla war against [[Ysanne Isard|Ysanne Isard's]] [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]], becoming a member of the independent "[[Antilles's Rogues]]" under the callsign [[Chir'daki One]]. Alongside his squadron, Tal'dira flew his Chir'daki in an [[Ambush of the bacta tankers|ambush against bacta tankers]], the [[Battle of Qretu 5]], and the [[Second ambush in the Graveyard]]. During these engagements, Tal'dira used his Chir'daki to cover Rogue Squadron from attack by the Isard-alligned [[Thyferran Home Defense Corps]], performing defence-in-depth tactics to delay the enemy so that Rogue Squadron could commit to critical strikes against the Imperial Remnant.<ref name="BW" />

The Chir'daki's final service under the Antilles's Rogues came during the climactic [[Battle of Thyferra]], wherein Tal'dira piloted the Ugly against the [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]], ''[[Lusankya/Legends|Lusankya]]'', and an overwhelming number of [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE Interceptors]] from the THDC. After the Battle of Thyferra concluded in victory for Antilles's Rogues and the New Republic, Tal'dira traded his Chir'daki for a T-65 X-wing to serve as a permanent member of Rogue Squadron.<ref name="BW" />
